product_name: vivo X300 FE 5G (Lilac Purple, 12GB RAM, 512GB Storage) with No Cost EMI/Additional Exchange Offers
description: [Capture Every Detail]: Shoot stunning, blur-free photos with a pro-level camera system featuring a 50MP ZEISS Main Camera (with OIS) IMX921 sensor, a 50MP ZEISS Telephoto Camera (with OIS) IMX882 sensor, and an 8MP Ultra Wide-Angle Camera. Enhance your shots with the ZEISS Multifocal Portrait for studio-quality depth, use the AI Creative Camera for intelligent scene optimization and instantly transfer your media with Shake & Share. [Flawless Selfies]: The 50MP ZEISS Wide-Angle Front Camera ensures you always look your best, delivering crisp, vibrant portraits and high-quality video calls. [Next-Gen Power]: Run your favorite apps, multitask, and game smoothly with the cutting-edge Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor. [Ample Storage & Lightning Speed]: Enjoy fast app loading and plenty of space for your memories with 12GB of LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and 512GB of fast UFS 4.1 internal storage. [Immersive 120Hz Display]: Dive into movies and games on the gorgeous 16.04cm (6.31") AMOLED Compact Screen , featuring a sharp 2640 × 1216 resolution and a hyper-smooth 120Hz refresh rate. [Eye-Friendly Viewing]: Experience cinematic color with HDR10+ support, paired with SGS Low Blue Light Certification to reduce eye strain during extended screen time. [Massive Battery Life]: Stay powered from morning to night without worry, thanks to a high-capacity 6500mAh Large Battery built for all-day endurance.
